title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Blue Razz Mojito Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Blue Razz Mojito by Doozy Infinity fuses tangy Blue Raspberry with the unmistakable zesty freshness of a sophisticated Mojito cocktail. The vibrant Blue Raspberry brings a sweet-sour burst up front, balanced by a zingy streak of Lime and a touch of herbal Mint, capturing the bright, refreshing spirit of a classic Mojito. A smooth wave of cool Ice on the exhale adds clarity and keeps the flavour sharp and beautifully defined from start to finish. With a 70VG/30PG high-VG formulation, this e-liquid is designed for Sub-Ohm vaping in powerful DTL (direct-to-lung) devices. Each 120ml bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, leaving room for two 10ml nic shots for a custom strength and nicotine level. The Doozy Infinity Shortfill range brings together richly flavoured, cloud-friendly blends designed to keep Sub-Ohm vapers coming back for more.
